statement.zh: 印度河文明是中央集权的统一帝国。
statement.en: The Indus Civilization was a centralized, unified empire.

disclaimer: Hypothesis: political organization (empire vs. heterarchy/city-states) remains debated; Kenoyer and others caution against simple empire models. Keep out of fact column.
